summary: Operacyjny nadzor dostawy i incydentow: read-only pilot

delivery.outcome: Publish the bounded read-only runtime readiness slice of the operational supervisor, with streaming diagnostics against an exact source SHA.
nonGoals: Service deployment or shared executor changes
Editing concurrent tickets or managed standards

architecture.decision: Standard-library CLI reads one immutable Git blob and probes fixed loopback routes in bounded disposable child processes sharing a parent deadline. Reports never contain HTTP bodies or confer execution authority.
architecture.rollback: Remove the additive CLI and tests; no runtime or stored data is changed.

validation.evidence: Immutable source, dirty workspace and malformed SHA tests
Owned HTTP fixtures, authentication boundary and redaction tests
Shared deadline, slow headers/body and streaming tests
Managed governance and read-only live observation
